service.title: The right care.
service.intro: Your solar installation deserves ongoing attention. We take care of what comes next.

items.title: We keep watch.
items.body: Our AI compares your production with the weather and nearby installations. An unusual drop? An alert within 24 hours, and a report every month.

items.title: We look after it.
items.body: Soliance Care includes one cleaning each year. Your panels are maintained, your installation monitored and your questions answered.

items.title: We are here.
items.body: With Care, travel and on-site diagnosis are included when a fault occurs. A local technician visits within 2 working days, subject to parts availability.

service.teamAlt: The Soliance team outside the Saint-Laurent-du-Var showroom
service.note: With Soliance Care: repair labour costs €120 including VAT; out-of-warranty parts are charged at cost. Phone, email and WhatsApp support 7 days a week.

monitor.eyebrow: Monitoring you can leave to us
monitor.title: Your production speaks.
monitor.body: You do not need to spend your day checking an app. We connect your inverter to our monitoring service, then follow your production through the day.

steps.title: We connect your installation.
steps.body: Using access to your manufacturer's app, with no extra equipment to install.

steps.title: We identify unusual changes.
steps.body: Production is compared with the weather to detect faults and gradual drops.

steps.title: We support you.
steps.body: An alert, a diagnosis, then a local visit if included in your plan.

warranty.eyebrow: Warranty support, without the back and forth
warranty.title: One point of contact.
warranty.body: If your inverter fails, we manage the claim with the manufacturer. You keep the same contact, from diagnosis to restarting the system.
steps: Remote diagnosis, followed by an on-site visit
Warranty claim sent to the manufacturer
warranty.note: Parts coverage depends on the manufacturer's warranty. With Care, repair labour is charged at €120 including VAT.

business.proBody: Soliance Care Pro for businesses and local authorities: €15 excluding VAT/kWp/year, or €12 above 250 kWp. Minimum €900 excluding VAT/year, 3-year commitment.
business.partnerBody: A white-label platform for installers. Starter licence for up to 100 sites: €99 excluding VAT/month, with free setup. 12-month commitment.

items.question: How does this differ from my inverter warranty?
items.answer: The manufacturer's warranty may cover a defective part under its terms. Soliance Care monitors your installation, diagnoses faults, manages the warranty claim and tracks the exchange. Repair labour is charged separately at the subscriber rate of €120 including VAT.

items.question: Is my inverter compatible?
items.answer: Soliance Care supports all brands, including SolaX, APsystems, Enphase, Huawei, Hoymiles, Deye, SMA, Fronius, SolarEdge, GoodWe, Growatt and Sungrow. A brand that has not yet been integrated is connected within 30 days. Connection uses your access to the manufacturer's app.

items.question: Do you operate in my region?
items.answer: Soliance Care on-site visits cover Alpes-Maritimes (06), Var (83) and Bouches-du-Rhône (13). Care Connect provides remote monitoring throughout France. Any visits under this plan are provided separately by a partner, subject to availability.

items.question: My installer has closed. Can you take over?
items.answer: Yes, within our service area, following a remote takeover audit costing €49.99 including VAT: a 30-minute video call with a technician. The takeover subscription then costs €24.99 including VAT/month with a 12-month commitment. Unfinished work or administrative procedures are quoted separately.

items.question: Are all repairs included?
items.answer: No. Soliance Care includes travel, diagnosis and warranty claim management. Repair labour costs €120 including VAT and out-of-warranty parts are charged at cost. Visits within 2 working days are subject to parts availability.

items.question: How does the commitment work?
items.answer: Soliance Care and Care Connect have a 12-month commitment. Soliance Care renews automatically; cancellation is online with one month's notice. The founding rate of €19.99 including VAT/month is guaranteed for 2 years for subscriptions before 31 December 2026. Subscription billing starts on 1 January 2027.

contact.title: Shall we talk?
contact.body: A question about production, a fault or a need for regular monitoring? Tell us about your installation. Our team will help you choose the next step.
